theorem _root_.CompressionEval.fresh_linear_algebra_combinatorics_05 {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f g h : ι → ℤ) (hfg : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≤ g i) (hgh : ∀ i ∈ s, g i ≤ h i) :
  (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, h i ∧ (∑ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, h i :=
by exact ⟨Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => (hfg i hi).trans (hgh i hi)), Finset.sum_le_sum hgh⟩
